fields.label: Default Label Type
fields.description: Label Type used when printing from the main list. Must be configured before printing.

fields.label: WebSocket Address
fields.description: URL of the WebSocket server that relays barcode scanner and scale readings. Expected message format: BARCODE:<value> or WEIGHT:<grams>. Example: ws://192.168.1.10:8765

fields.label: Google TTS API Key
fields.description: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech API key. Used to announce prices aloud when an item is scanned. Leave blank to disable voice announcements.

fields.label: Packaging Bag Item
fields.description: Item charged for single-use packaging bags on weighted labels (e.g. a plastic bag fee). When selected, the bag fee is added to the printed label total.

fields.label: Default Warehouse Group
fields.description: Warehouse group used to filter stock level lookups.

fields.label: Default Warehouse
fields.description: Specific warehouse used for stock level display in the item list.
